ecological_source_pool.provenance: <fixed cutoff period or frozen source set>
ecological_source_pool.eligible_pool_count: <integer >= 24 for combined mode, or >= 12 per wave for separate mode>
ecological_source_pool.anchor_rule: <at least one exact-owner and one legitimate-new-artifact anchor per wave, fixed before seeded selection if needed>
exclusion_rules: cannot be run identically in both arms

secondary_endpoints: calls before first explicit visible owner or route assertion when observable
measured context or token volume when available

ecological_correctness_non_regression.metric: median paired total correctness delta B-A

cost_gate.applies_to: all valid ecological cases including serious-error-prevention cases
cost_gate.zero_denominator_rule: if A=0 and B=0 ratio=1.0; if A=0 and B>0 ratio=infinity
cost_gate.serious_error_prevention_exception: none; all such cases remain in the primary gate
cost_gate.unavailable_token_or_time_metrics: exclude from gate; report as unavailable

pilot_interpretation.provisional_correctness_signal: >=2 A-wrong/B-correct, 0 reverse serious errors, ecological correctness non-regression passes, pilot cost gate passes
pilot_interpretation.weak_correctness_signal: exactly 1 A-wrong/B-correct, 0 reverse serious errors, ecological correctness non-regression passes
pilot_interpretation.provisional_efficiency_signal: efficiency gain rule passes with non-worse correctness and 0 reverse serious errors
pilot_interpretation.pilot_regression: reverse serious-error reversal or ecological correctness non-regression failure

final_decision_rule.correctness_gain_cost_not_accepted: correctness reversal thresholds met but primary all-case cost gate fails in either wave
final_decision_rule.not_confirmed: pilot correctness signal not supported by independent confirmatory corpus
final_decision_rule.no_incremental_value: neither demonstrated correctness nor demonstrated efficiency rule met without material treatment regression
final_decision_rule.regression: any reverse serious-error reversal or material ecological correctness non-regression failure
final_decision_rule.inconclusive: protocol, isolation, source-state, model compatibility, or scoring defect prevents defensible comparison

equal_correctness_sensitivity.case_filter: ecological pairs with equal total correctness score and equal serious-error status

diagnostic_c.timing: after both primary waves and scores are frozen

stopping_rule: Complete all 48 preregistered primary A/B runs under the default protocol; do not stop for Pilot performance.
unblinding_rule: Score arm-hidden response copies against the frozen wave-specific key before revealing treatment labels whenever practical.
